fusions.name: Crossroads Dart
fusions.desc: Sends a razor draught into the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 damage, then splits to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 70% of the damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Two Tines
fusions.desc: A two-pronged weapon strike wrapped in wind that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Both Roads
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and you finish 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Splinter Crit
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a bolt of lightning splits off to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
